page.notes: The words "ut" and "non" are printed on the last line and the catchword. The printed text on the last line is "ut", followed by the catchword "non" alone at the lower right. The text "pactionibus & testamentis" is set in italic in the source; the italic was preserved. Several "s" letters are rendered as "f" in the printed face and were normalised to plain s per the long-s rule (e.g. "fuisse", "consulerentur", "posi-tam"). "fi" was read as "si". "quæ forté" is read as printed, with the acute accent on forté as shown. Some uncertainty in "ut iudi-ciorum" (possible space between ut and iudi). Printed page number "2o" read as 20. The ornament below the text is not text.
